01 A little about me

I’m a developer who enjoys connecting a thoughtful interface with the logic that makes it work, supported by full-stack development training in Java, Python, OOP, DSA, SQL, HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and backend development.

My work spans document-grounded chatbots and platforms that make sharing academic resources easier. I care about clear user flows, reliable backend logic, and well-organized relational data.

With a background in Computer Science & Artificial Intelligence and hands-on full-stack training, I’m always learning through building. That curiosity also led me to research secure digital identity, take part in hackathons, and earn my Salesforce certification.

Building at the intersection of web development and AI.

RAGbot — Chat with Documents

A full-stack RAG chatbot that turns your documents into a conversation. Upload PDF, DOCX, TXT, or Markdown files and get context-grounded answers with source citations.
